purpose: Test moving versus fixed spectral peaks in existing approved F3 acceleration intervals, without a shared-phase/RPM or physical-source claim
guide: Use all existing accel_material_v1/observe1 candidate ratios and support flags unchanged; do not refit or interpolate the guide
tolerance: One native FFT bin from each observation propagated through the ratio, plus half a guide grid step: df*(1+ratio)+expectedHz*(2**(0.5/192)-1). Engineering matching radius, not an error/confidence bound
association: Each reference/current pair within radius forms an edge; accept only degree1 at BOTH ends. All missing and ambiguous entries retained; no nearest-neighbour substitution
classification: Only nonreference supported-guide windows whose moving/fixed predictions differ by more than twice the larger radius. At least5 such windows; candidate hypothesis >=0.8support, alternative <=0.2support, and >=5consecutive original-window successes. No linking gaps
known_controls: only fixed tones with a false moving guide
a removed moving line with a displaced neighbour
same mono noise in both channels
followup_control: After observe1 showed many raw moving matches but intermittent competing fixed matches, retain observe1 and add a known dense moving harmonic comb (orders5..30,60Hz base,exact same sweep). Report the original classifier's false uncertainty; do not relax its rules or relabel the recordings
scope: Native0.25s periodic-Hann inventory and explicit guided peak correspondence only. Not OSC/physical source identity, fundamental, engine clock, measured RPM/load, phase qualification, timbre acceptance or new runtime profile
preserve: old binaries/takes and pending idle listening question
